hero.title: Reviving India's Ecological and Cultural Heritage
hero.subtitle: Lakshya Paryawaran and Jankalyan Sanstha (Go Mandir)
hero.description: Through indigenous cow conservation, natural healing, and sustainable rural development, we blend traditional Indian wisdom with sustainable innovation.

about.title: Who We Are
about.subtitle: Guardians of Bharatiya Parampara
about.description: Lakshya Paryawaran and Jankalyan Sanstha is a grassroots organization dedicated to ecological restoration, indigenous cow conservation, natural healing, and rural empowerment. Founded to revive Bharatiya parampara through self-reliant practices, we blend traditional knowledge with sustainable innovation to serve communities and protect nature.
about.visionText: To restore balance between human life, nature, and culture by promoting cow-centric, eco-friendly, and self-sustaining rural models.
missionPoints: Protect and promote indigenous cow breeds
Train rural communities in herbal wellness and zero-cost farming
Create models of swadeshi economy through cow-based enterprises

goMandir.title: Go Mandir
goMandir.description: A sanctuary for native cows and a center for cultural, ecological, and economic revival. Water table raised from 410ft to 120ft, thousands of acres revived, chemical-free agriculture, women's empowerment.

healthcare.title: Self-Reliant Healthcare Training
healthcare.description: Equipping rural families and women with acupressure, naturopathy, and Panchgavya chikitsa skills for community wellness.

agriculture.title: Sustainable Agriculture
agriculture.description: Promoting poison-free farming using cow dung, urine, and local soil microbes for healthy food production.

conservation.title: Forest and Wildlife Conservation
conservation.description: Reviving habitats and protecting biodiversity in crisis-affected regions through natural restoration methods.

water.title: Water Rejuvenation Projects
water.description: Transforming dry lands into water-rich ecosystems through traditional water conservation techniques.

naturopathy.title: Prakratik Chikitsa (Naturopathy)
naturopathy.description: Ancient therapies using earth, water, fire, air, and ether. Personalized treatments, yoga, mud therapy, hydrotherapy, and diet-based interventions.

panchgavya.title: Panchgavya Chikitsa
panchgavya.description: Holistic healing using cow-derived elements (milk, curd, ghee, urine, dung). Consultations, therapies, and training available.

education.title: Education & Courses
education.subtitle: Learning Traditional Wisdom
education.collaborationText: In partnership with Dr. Sarvapalli Radhakrishnan Rajasthan Ayurved University, we offer certified courses in Panchgavya-based health, native cattle preservation, and cow-based entrepreneurship.

volunteer.title: Volunteer & Join Us
volunteer.subtitle: Be Part of the Change
volunteer.description: Experience spiritual joy and hands-on learning while serving cows, learning natural therapies, farming sustainably, or contributing to rural development.
opportunitiesList: Serve cows and learn animal care
Teach and share knowledge with communities

dairy.title: Dairy Products
dairy.description: A2 milk, ghee, buttermilk, paneer—pure, chemical-free, and traditionally prepared from our indigenous cows.

herbal.title: Herbal Soaps
herbal.description: Handcrafted using cow dung ash, cow urine distillate, neem, tulsi, hibiscus, and multani mitti. Skin-friendly, eco-safe, and supports local women's groups.

panchgavya.title: Panchgavya Products
panchgavya.description: Natural wellness products based on Vedic wisdom, promoting health and spiritual well-being.

impact.title: Our Impact
impact.subtitle: Transforming Communities
achievementsList: 1000+ rural women trained in natural healing
Thousands of acres of grazing and forest land restored
Chemical-free farming model adopted by local farmers
impact.testimonial1: Our village is greener, healthier, and more self-reliant thanks to Go Mandir.
impact.testimonial2: Panchgavya therapies have transformed our health and reduced medical expenses.
